impact_assessment.why: Incorporate literature review on cognitive scaffolding, tutorial design, and narrative transportation into VoidFarer, integrating an interactive Cadet Flight Academy and branching story campaign
impact_assessment.benefits: Dramatically flattens onboarding learning curve, immerses player in compelling sci-fi mystery, maximizes attention retention, and rewards progression through story relics
impact_assessment.risks: contract: API/CLI backward compatibility with existing save states; dependency: zero external packages allowed; concurrency: thread-safe engine mutations for story choices and tutorial advancement; state: seamless migration of existing saved ships without tutorial/story fields
impact_assessment.mitigation: Default field values in frozen dataclasses, pure standard library implementation, thread mutex locks on story resolution, and comprehensive unit test coverage

impact_assessment.why: Build VoidFarer: an autonomous deep-space fleet, procedural galaxy, and holographic cockpit simulation engine with zero external dependencies
impact_assessment.benefits: Provides an engaging, high-fidelity procedural simulation engine, rich CLI, and breathtaking Web Audio/Canvas holographic cockpit HUD while adhering 100% to AIKit principles
impact_assessment.risks: contract: REST API and CLI schema alignment; dependency: zero external packages allowed; concurrency: multi-threaded HTTP server and state atomicity; state: power-loss safe storage
impact_assessment.mitigation: Frozen dataclass contracts, Python standard library only, thread-safe state mutex with atomic replace, and comprehensive sub-second test suite
